MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. When learning Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Production.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Production.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Production.

4. When learning Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.

5. When learning Introduction to Media Technology, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Media Technology.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Media Technology.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Media Technology.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Media Technology.

6. When learning Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.

7. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

8. When learning Digital Video Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Video Production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Digital Video Production.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Video Production.

9. When learning Post- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post- production.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Post- production.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post- production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.

10. When learning Photography, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Photography.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography.

11. When learning Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.

12. When learning Audio Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audio Production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Audio Production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audio Production.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Post- production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Photography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Digital Video Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. A — CPU

2. D — Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Production.

4. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.

5. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Media Technology.

6. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.

7. B — Information and Communication Technology

8. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production.

9. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.

10. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography.

11. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.

12. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Post- production; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Photography; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Digital Video Production; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
